claims.title: Functional repair: complete filling, renewed access and useful pressure loads

quoted_fields.interface: Actual missing material, retained load, mixing, transport, cure, temporary support, useful force-displacement-work and renewed access belong to the complete operation. The hydraulic example assumes a rectangular throat and prescribed cure-front growth; the pressure screen assumes an undeformed isotropic thick cylinder. Neither constitutive law is a measured actuator or resin model.
quoted_fields.failure: Prepared epoxy fractures with pumping, support, manual cleanup, long cure or clamping are not autonomous soft actuators. Manually realigned tensile cuts and limited contact tests do not qualify a useful pressure body or repeated damaged-device life. External sealing, recovered shape or compensated force can coexist with missing material or depleted redundancy. All numerical laws below are introduced; no actual cure window, renewed conduit or restored useful-load life is established.
